snippet.title: Streetdog BMX Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Streetdog BMX is dropping on Steam on January 14th 2026 - get ready to shred!

Streetdog BMX is an action sports game where you ride through epic maps sending extreme tricks, getting technical on the rails, and feeling the flow. Fans of Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater and Dave Mirra BMX will be right at home in this deep yet approachable modern BMX game.

Customize your bike and rider before hitting the streets to explore six maps packed with wallrides, gaps, bowls, ramps and rails. Uncover new spots, complete handcrafted challenges, and link up your combos!
